scope: TG1A inference metadata batch compatibility and failed-runtime isolation only

change: Add the already-declared temporal_grounding_context metadata key to the inference batch builder allowlist.
Retain runner extraction and backend intervention logic unchanged.

invariants: Checkpoint, model weights, processor, images, actions, action frequency, H=E=36, tasks, scenes, seeds, retry limit, intervention definitions, shuffle mapping, result selection, and analysis remain unchanged.
The metadata context is excluded from the tensor batch exactly as before and is passed separately to the frozen backend intervention route.
No episode or summary from runtime v4 is reused.
